title: Elf Bar 600 Cherry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods provide a convenient and cost-effective way to enjoy the brand’s signature flavours. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw and fast-acting nicotine relief. Cherry Ice Flavour: A bold and juicy cherry flavour with just the right balance of sweetness and tang. The deep, rich berry notes are perfectly complemented by a crisp menthol exhale, delivering a refreshingly cool finish. Swapping pods is quick and hassle-free—simply click a fresh one into place and continue vaping. Whether you're looking for an easy alternative to disposables or a more efficient way to enjoy your favourite Elf Bar flavours, these prefilled pods offer a simple, mess-free vaping experience.
